researchConclusion: Bounded public checks did not yield usable distinct dealer artwork. Generic text banners or unavailable image-host URLs do not prove that the dealer has no logo. This artwork is clearly an independent proposal.

generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Produce one professional dealer-logo asset on a truly transparent background. Wide horizontal lockup with a separate compact emblem at left, generous transparent gap, and the exact business name at right in bold custom geometric lettering. The emblem must stay clear at 32px, thick strokes and few shapes. Flat crisp vector-like artwork; no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no photography, no extra text. Every dark element must have a fine white outer keyline and every white element a dark navy outline, so this identical master works on white, charcoal #111113 and dark red #c40101. Use a clean solid silhouette, not decorative outlines. This is an independent proposal, not dealer-approved artwork. Exact name: PROMISE CARS. Left emblem is a simple P formed from two interlocking cobalt-blue #2863d6 bands with one open road notch; no checkmark or shield. Strong, balanced, reassuring mark. PROMISE large, CARS small but bold beneath it. Navy and cobalt with precise white keylines.
